_comment_address: The node's etherbase: every block reward lands here. For payouts the node keystore must hold this key and --http.api must include personal (core-geth), or sign payouts elsewhere.

rewardRecipients._comment: Pool fee percentages by address, e.g. "0xFeeAddress": 1.0

_comment_daemons: core-geth on the ETC mainnet: geth --classic --http --http.api eth,net,web3,miner --mine --miner.threads=0 --miner.etherbase <address>. See docs/ethash.md.

paymentProcessing._comment_paymentMode: prop (round shares) | solo (finder takes all) | pplns (last-N window, n x block difficulty)
paymentProcessing._comment_minConf: Confirmations before a block matures. 120 at ~13 s blocks is about 26 minutes; ETC exchanges typically wait longer, the pool only needs the block to be final.
paymentProcessing._comment_accountPassword: Keystore password for personal_unlockAccount before each payout run.

_comment_ports: diff is the share difficulty in hashes (1 = 1 hash); size it at hashrate x seconds per share. 8003: GPUs (an RTX 4090 does ~130 MH/s on Etchash, ~5e8 at 4 s), varDiff covers 10-500 MH/s rigs. 8004: Etchash ASICs (Antminer E9 Pro 3.7 GH/s, E11 9.5 GH/s, Jasminer X-series) and proxies, fixed at 4e10. Both ports speak the eth-proxy stratum dialect every current miner and ASIC supports.

8004._comment: Fixed high-difficulty port for ASICs and farm proxies.
